item.tib: kun bzang bla med thugs kyi yang thig rgyud las sngon 'gro khrid kyi gong brgyan khrid gsum gnad kyi sgron me
item.coloph: kun bzang bla med kyi dgongs pa/ 'chi med rig 'dzin gyi thugs bcud/ gsang bdag slob dpon chen po'i mdzad srol/ ma sring mkha' 'gro rnams kyi gdams pa zab mo/ ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams kyi spyod yul/ 'khor 'dam skam gyi nyi ma/ thar pa'i lam 'dren/ nye lam gcig gcod kyi gdams pa 'di ni lho nub pad ma 'bar ba'i zhing khams su/ me pho sprel gyi lo la/ sprel zla tshes bcu'i nyin par/ gsang ba'i bdag nyid mkha' 'gro zil gnon dbyings phyug gsang bdag dpal ldan chen po gnyis kyi/ snyigs ma'i kho bo byang chub rtsal gyi gling pa bdag gi snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis gsang sbas bka' rgya ci bzhin thub par byed(byas)/ phyi rabs 'gro ba'i don du gsang ba bla med theg pa chen po 'di/ gsang ba'i gnas mchog shel le rdzong drug tu me lug zla tshes bzang po la zab mo gtan la phab pa'o/ 'gro kun thar pa chen po thob pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig sA mA yA/ rgyargyargya//
